reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the missing/number/range-furthest-from-zero rule used by the rest of the app.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and the APIScheduleEntity type, the layer that shapes schedules for the API.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the relative '../shared/schedules' import departs from the tree's alias style and the optional field on the input type relies on a comment to say it is read-only.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule lives only in getScheduledAmount.
